recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless maintainers choose to regenerate checked-in diagrams from the authoritative StructureDefinition source.
issue_request: FHIR-20575 was a Published OO change request asking whether DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier.deviceIdentifier and .issuer should reuse Device.udiCarrier definitions. The final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution chose not to reference Device definitions and instead to fix typos in DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier.deviceIdentifier.
initial_application: Jira cites PR #1446 commit 4449221765b46ac3f6a40400c2fbba4c86fc2627. Git history shows 5b2f0040172d0f9c392d8d3e15ec4854aa4bdd79 corrected 'jurisdication porvided' to 'jurisdiction provided' in the active DeviceDefinition StructureDefinition, and later commit 02e9b7adbd40e38f32f47d36eb97b699294074fd corrected the remaining 'DeviceDefintiion' misspelling while formatting the same text.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Device and DeviceDefinition as active resources. Current source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml has corrected local text, while Device.udiCarrier definitions remain independent as the Jira resolution intended. Related later No Change issues FHIR-20564 and FHIR-20576 declined cross-resource invariants for Device/DeviceDefinition UDI-DI and issuer alignment. Searches found stale 'DeviceDefintiion' only in generated-looking SVG diagram tooltip artifacts.
reconciliation: No source change was made. An empty audit commit records that the authoritative active StructureDefinition source already satisfies FHIR-20575 and that manually editing checked-in SVG diagrams would not be an appropriate source-only fix.
